verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly markets building workflows for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers, and webhooks are documented to trigger on feedback/status events, supporting the automation premise. However there is no detailed documentation of the workflow builder itself (conditions, actions, UI) nor independent/hands-on corroboration that these specific triggers work as described. Missing for 10: detailed workflow configuration docs, concrete examples of SLA/trial/discount automations in action, independent verification.
